items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: Because I heard him at the Adolphus Hotel in Dallas

ctx.x: Would you be listening to black bands like Alfonso Trent, Troy Floyd, Don Albert?

Very much so. Don Albert? Don Albert, I hadn't heard at that time. I did hear him in 1930 in Vermont, and he was great. But Alfonso Trent, I have written a lot about Alfonso, I mean to different people like Frank Dricks and so on. Because I heard him at the Adolphus Hotel in Dallas, at which time this was the fanciest and best hotel in Texas. And they were good. They just were good. And they were, I mean this was before Basie and before any of those bands, even the Kansas City bands like George Lee and Benny…
